headline: Agenda posted for Policy Committee meeting covering new bylaws and policy revisions
summary: This document is an agenda, not meeting minutes. It lists planned discussion items including new bylaws on board member internet use, requests for information, and administrative regulations, plus proposed revisions to bylaws on minutes and electronic mail, and a presentation on a parent portal policy.
